scope.question: Does official primary-source evidence establish that Ntahangwa's administrative identity/delimitation postdates the retained geoBoundaries BDI ADM2 source represented-year claim of 2007?

primary_sources.title: Plan National de Développement du Burundi 2018–2027
primary_sources.publisher: Présidence de la République du Burundi
primary_sources.substance: The plan reports administrative redistricting of provinces and communes, including delimitation and regrouping of the communes of Bujumbura Mairie into three communes named Muha, Ntahangwa, and Mukaza.

primary_sources.title: Communiqué de presse no. 11, Conseil des Ministres, 15 June 2022
primary_sources.publisher: Présidence de la République du Burundi
primary_sources.substance: The communiqué says Burundi then counted 18 provinces and 119 communes; recounts the 2005 assimilation of Bujumbura Mairie as a province and zones as communes; and describes a proposed new delimitation/re-grouping from 119 to 42 communes. It lists Ntahangwa among the proposed commune composition and records a recommendation to locate its seat at Mutimbuzi. This is a Council communiqué describing an adopted draft project and recommendations, not proof by itself that the later project was promulgated or that any particular boundary was adopted.

primary_sources.title: Loi n°1/33 du 28 novembre 2014 portant révision de la loi sur l'organisation de l'administration communale
primary_sources.publisher: Présidence de la République du Burundi
primary_sources.official_pdf_access: Fetch failed with HTTP 400 from document service because reported content length was 13,480,065 bytes; body/pages were not read. No retry or alternate transfer attempted.
primary_sources.substance: The official Presidency page identifies the enacted law and date, but the law text itself was not directly inspected in this pass.

assessment.finding: There is affirmative official evidence that Bujumbura Mairie communes were delimited and regrouped into the three-commune arrangement including Ntahangwa by the 2018 plan, after the retained ADM2 catalogue's claimed 2007 representation year. This makes a source-vintage/identity applicability question concrete; it is not merely inferred from matching names.
not_established: The available evidence does not establish that the retained 2007 Ntahangwa feature is geometrically the 2014/2018 Ntahangwa commune, nor provide an old-to-new polygon crosswalk.
The 2022 communiqué's 42-commune delineation is a proposal/project account; it is not treated as promulgation evidence.
No conclusion is made about present legal authority, source clearance, geometry correctness, or per-cell causal attribution.
assessment.next_evidence_if_needed: Directly inspect the 2014 official law text/annex and any enacted map or legally documented predecessor-to-successor membership table; exact geometry equivalence would still require separate evidence.

related_retained_context.scope_note: Existing comparison is 21 retained 2007 ADM2 target polygons against 18 retained 2014 ADM1 features plus COD/TZA contexts; it is not an old-to-new Ntahangwa crosswalk.
